notes.title: v[1.004] Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features and improvements:

[b][h3]1) New Map [/h3][/b]
We've added a new map: Map-7.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753153/5e05b4ee1f0fec0078e3e3fce47c88ff8a032030.png[/img]

[b][h3]2) New Button: Skip to Huddle-up Ceremony [/h3][/b]
After you start a Huddle-up, a skip button appears on the top-left corner of the screen.
When you press the skip button, all penguins will be ready in the location and then celebrate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753153/59756fdd15403af7354a02a20e280a35e24b2183.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753153/de397de0d30f08dc3a84fe107dc291926d442b54.png[/img]

[b][h3]3) Transfer Center Idle List [/h3][/b]
We've added the education levels of the penguins in the Transfer Center's idle list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753153/1a0779021704a99977140982e457128eaa2450c3.png[/img]

All the best
TR Games
